name: Claude Code Game Studios
purpose: Claude-oriented game-production template. Borrow concise art direction, asset provenance, and observed-playtest gates; adapt to the consuming agent and avoid installing its full hierarchy into an existing project.

name: UnrealClaude
purpose: Claude Code/editor and MCP integration for Unreal Engine 5.7. Relevant to Unreal projects; requires the engine and compatible editor plugin, not an upgrade path for a small WebView game.

name: Godot MCP
purpose: Launch and inspect Godot projects through MCP. Candidate for a deliberate Godot port; existing three.js projects do not gain Godot features by adding this server.

name: ACE-Step 1.5
purpose: Local music authoring model for exporting game soundtrack files. Generate on the development machine and ship audio, not the model. Select model/backend by available GPU memory.

name: Blender Lab MCP
purpose: Official Blender Lab bridge for scene inspection and Python automation. Small first-party candidate for modeling, material work, and export; requires Blender 5.1+, add-on, server and MCP client.

name: MCP for Blender
purpose: Third-party Blender authoring/MCP bridge with render inspection and optional asset/model services. More features than the minimal Blender Lab bridge; audit external-service and telemetry options.

name: glTF Transform
purpose: Script GLB/glTF inspection, deduplication, resizing and optimization in a repeatable asset build pipeline. Fits three.js and engines that import glTF.

name: meshoptimizer / gltfpack
purpose: Reduce mesh size and rendering cost; gltfpack optimizes glTF assets. Suitable after visual baseline checks, especially repeated props and LODs.

name: KTX Software
purpose: KTX2 texture authoring/transcoding tools for mobile GPU texture budgets. Consider only after profiling; compressed download size differs from decoded GPU memory.

name: glTF Validator
purpose: Validate binary and JSON glTF, buffer access, references and specification conformance before integrating assets.

name: Blender glTF importer/exporter
purpose: Official Khronos Blender glTF pipeline for baking/exporting engine-portable geometry, materials and animation.

name: Mobile MCP
purpose: Local Android/iOS device and emulator control through accessibility snapshots or screenshot coordinates. Useful for native startup, save and lifecycle QA.

name: Maestro
purpose: Repeatable Android UI flows for installation, menus, permissions and lifecycle smoke tests; complements renderer-level and manual gameplay checks.

name: jsfxr
purpose: Author small synthesized feedback sounds and export WAV files for offline games. Good for rewards/tool/UI cues, less suited to realistic wind or character foley.

name: Audacity MCP
purpose: Automate audio cleanup, editing and export through a local Audacity scripting bridge. Candidate for finishing recorded ambience or generated music.

name: Kenney Train Kit
purpose: Coherent train, carriage and rail models for a stylized railway game. Select a small subset, recolor and add original settlement details.

name: Kenney Nature Kit
purpose: Low-poly pines, rocks, logs, bridges and camp props suitable for a consistent mobile environment. Snow treatment and game-specific silhouettes still need an art pass.

name: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack
purpose: Alternative low-poly nature collection including pine/snowy variants; useful when it provides better silhouettes than the primary chosen kit.

name: Poly Haven
purpose: Source HDRIs, textures and models for authored materials and lighting references. Downsample and stylize selected assets for mobile rather than importing high-resolution packs wholesale.

name: ambientCG
purpose: Source CC0 snow, wood, rock and other surfaces for a constrained material palette. Bake/resize only selected maps and budget decoded GPU memory.

name: Kenney Food Kit
purpose: Small stylized food, cookware and table props for offline games. Select only needed GLBs and their palette texture; keep edible props out of automatic snow shaders.

name: Bevy
purpose: Build games with Rust and an entity-component-system architecture; track API migration requirements.

name: Defold
purpose: Develop and export games with Lua scripting; review the custom license and target-platform requirements.

name: Phaser
purpose: Create browser games with JavaScript or TypeScript; test rendering and input on target devices.

name: PixiJS
purpose: Render interactive 2D graphics in browsers; choose compatible rendering backends and asset pipelines.

name: Babylon.js
purpose: Build browser 3D scenes and applications; measure GPU capabilities and asset loading.

name: Rapier
purpose: Integrate Rust-based 2D or 3D rigid-body physics; validate bindings and simulation settings.

name: Jolt Physics
purpose: C++ rigid-body simulation for games; verify compiler, CPU features and integration model.

name: Box2D
purpose: Simulate 2D rigid bodies; review current API generation and numerical assumptions.

name: raylib
purpose: Build graphics and games with a compact C API; confirm backend and platform build dependencies.

name: Flecs
purpose: Add an entity-component system to C or C++ applications; plan data ownership and scheduling.

name: ezEngine
purpose: An open source C++ game engine.

name: nCine
purpose: A cross-platform 2D game engine

name: game-datasets
purpose: :video_game: A curated list of awesome game datasets, and tools to artificial intelligence in games
